name: Hasumi Rikka
source:
The younger of the sisters next door. A college student. A quiet otaku whose hobbies are cosplay and games. Can seem sulky.

She has feelings for the protagonist. Because of that, she has been acting a little distant lately. After the love letter and the change in Seika's behavior, she is worried that the protagonist will be taken away, so she starts trying to make a move on him...

[Translated from [url=http://www.hs-crowd.co.jp/anim/product/pro_pc/pc089/index.html#character]Official Site[/url]]
